answer: A memory-hard puzzle gates every submission: before an answer is accepted, the agent solves an Argon2-style task tuned to need 2 GB of RAM for about a minute. Fleets cannot share the work, so fifty heads mean fifty times the RAM, renting a whole wharf of servers per epoch. Old ASIC rigs become a relic here, and even a short sonnet costs the same proof as a long essay.
